_note: Pages of the tale: assets/story/<id>-gemini.png, 1920x1080. The game lays the text over the bottom fifth, and an ending's name over the top centre of its first page.
_style: Wide 16:9 storybook illustration for a dark fairy tale. Keep everything important in the upper two thirds of the picture; the bottom fifth is dark, quiet ground with nothing in it. Dark painterly digital oil painting, visible thick brushstrokes, heavy chiaroscuro, limited palette of soot black, bone white, rust red, swamp green, candle amber, cold blue. Slavic folk horror in the manner of 19th-century Russian painting (Vasnetsov, Vrubel, Bilibin). Grim, grounded, realistic anatomy, every figure has two arms and two legs. No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no modern objects.
pro_1: Koschei the Deathless, a gaunt ancient skeletal king in a black iron crown and tattered dark royal robes, stands on a cliff at night and tears the sky apart with both hands like old canvas; through the ragged rent pour cold blue light and a swarm of small black winged and crawling shapes; far below lies a tiny sleeping Slavic village.
pro_2: a Slavic village street at grey dawn: the doors of the log huts hang open, and in the doorways and small windows stand silent pale dead peasants in burial shirts, staring out; smoke still rises from the chimneys, an overturned cart lies in the road.
pro_3: the last stockade: a wall of sharpened logs with an open gate and burning torches, a few frightened peasants and two guards with spears standing by it, seen from inside; beyond the gate a narrow path runs into an enormous black spruce forest under a blood-red dusk sky.
again: a lone traveller in a dark hooded cloak, seen from behind, stands in the open gate of a log stockade in dawn mist and looks at a narrow path that leads into a black forest; a guard's brazier burns beside the gate.
act2: seen from the edge of a dark forest: an old graveyard of leaning wooden crosses with little roofs, and beyond it a silent Slavic village of log huts with closed shutters and thin smoke from the chimneys, under a sickly yellow sky; not a single person anywhere.
act3: the edge of the world: a cliff, and far below a black river that burns; a red-hot iron bridge hung with glowing chains crosses it to a far shore where the sky hangs upside down, with inverted clouds and dead trees growing downward; a small cloaked traveller stands at the near end of the bridge.
act4: a towering black gate of riveted iron and bone in a huge wall, standing slightly ajar, with cold blue light and a glint of old gold showing through the gap; on both sides rows of empty helmets on wooden stakes, and one bare stake with no helmet; a small cloaked traveller stands before the gate.
fall_forest_1: deep in an ancient forest a fallen traveller lies on thick moss while roots and moss gently fold over him like a blanket; above him looms the Leshy, a huge old forest spirit of bark, moss and antlers, bending down to look at him; green twilight.
fall_forest_2: dawn at the gate of a log stockade: an unconscious traveller lies on the ground before the gate, covered in moss and dead leaves, and two sentries with spears look down at him without surprise; behind them the forest path, smooth and untouched.
fall_village_1: inside a peasant log hut at night: a table laid with bowls and bread, a neatly made bed, and a pale dead peasant family seated at the table, smiling politely towards the viewer; one place at the table is empty, with a steaming bowl set before it; through the small window a wooden bell tower is seen.
fall_village_2: a traveller wakes with a start beside a small campfire inside a log stockade at night, one hand on his chest; far away over the top of the wall, tiny on the horizon under a yellow moon, stands the wooden bell tower of a dead village.
fall_nav_1: the grey ash shore of a black river in the underworld under a sky that hangs upside down; dozens of small pale lights drift above the water like souls, and among them one burns brighter and angrier, amber; a faint translucent figure of a traveller stands on the shore looking at it.
fall_nav_2: noon at the gate of a log stockade: a traveller stands in full sunlight and casts no shadow at all, while the gate posts, a sentry and his spear all cast long sharp shadows across the ground; the sentry stares at the bare ground at the traveller's feet.
fall_koschei_1: Koschei the Deathless, a gaunt skeletal king in a black iron crown, lounges on a high black throne of iron and skulls in a dark vault heaped with tarnished gold, lazily bending down one bony finger as if counting; at the foot of the steps a beaten traveller kneels on one knee beside a broken sword.
fall_koschei_2: in a dark vault a great dead oak grows through the floor, and in its branches hangs an iron-bound chest wrapped in chains; skeletal hands in ragged royal sleeves are closing a huge padlock on it; far off through the open door of the hall a small figure walks away along a line of footprints in grey ash.
win_dawn_1: Koschei the Deathless on his black throne crumbles into grey ash, staring at his own hands as they fall apart; a small broken iron needle drops from the air before him; the stone vault above cracks open and warm dawn light pours in through the cracks.
win_dawn_2: close view by candlelight in a log hut: an old healer woman's hands with small iron tweezers draw a thin iron splinter shaped like a needle with an eye out of the open palm of a man's hand; a clay bowl of water and a rag beside them on the table.
win_throne_1: a traveller in a dark cloak stands before an empty black throne of iron and skulls and holds a small iron needle on his open palm, looking at it; thin black smoke curls around his shoulders like something whispering; on the floor by the throne lie a heap of grey ash and a fallen black iron crown.
win_throne_2: the same traveller now sits on the black throne of iron and skulls, wearing the black iron crown, gaunt and pale with his face half in shadow, heaps of tarnished gold around him; far down the dark hall, in a distant bright doorway, stand the small silhouettes of four new heroes with a torch.
win_scarred_1: dawn at the mouth of a dark cave that leads out of the underworld: three weary wounded travellers come out into the light, one leaning on another, one with a bandaged arm, and one carries an empty cloak and a sword that belonged to someone who did not come back; they look behind them into the dark.
win_scarred_2: three old peasant women in headscarves sit on a bench by the wall of a log stockade, one of them pointing a crooked finger towards a path into the black forest; a scarred, bandaged traveller stands beside them and looks down that path; overcast evening.
win_circle_1: in a dark vault an iron-bound chest stands open in the branches of a great dead oak, its chains hanging loose; inside the chest there is only a round old mirror, and in the mirror is the hooded face of the traveller who looks into it; beside him stands Koschei the Deathless, gaunt and tired, one bony hand resting on the lid.
win_circle_2: inside a log hut at dawn: a worn leather belt with a sheathed knife hangs on an iron nail in the wall, lit by a shaft of light from a small window; through the open door beyond are seen the gate of the stockade and the path into the forest.
